material.title: CISA adds CVE-2026-21589 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
material.bodyOriginal: CISA has added one new vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog: CVE-2026-21589, affecting Microsoft Windows Server (affected versions are documented in the NVD record). This type of vulnerability is a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors. Required action: apply updates per vendor instructions. Due date: 2026-10-22.

material.title: PoC released for Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49/2.4.50 path traversal
material.bodyOriginal: New public proof-of-concept for CVE-2021-42013 (Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50). The script sends a crafted request and returns the contents of files outside the document root; the only prerequisite is a default CGI-enabled configuration. A nuclei template is included in the repository.

material.title: Narrow vendor advisory with affected and fixed versions
material.bodyOriginal: A vulnerability has been identified in Vendor Product 4.8.2 and earlier. An authenticated attacker with access to the administrative interface could delete arbitrary files. A patch is available in 4.9.0. No exploitation has been observed.
